storyboard_arc.setup: Raindrops tap softly against the glass, matching the slow, steady rhythm of a lazy morning.
storyboard_arc.disruption: The steady downpour outside seems to blur the edges of the world, slowing everything right down.
storyboard_arc.choice: There is no need to rush when the weather itself is telling everyone to take a break.
storyboard_arc.puzzle_moment: The daily rule changes the move, so Isla checks it before trusting the answer.
storyboard_arc.consequence: With the trickier parts of the puzzle sorted, the rest of the pieces fall into place.
storyboard_arc.resolution: Watching the rain gather on the leaves outside, she finally feels ready to start her day.

captions:
Let's ease into things today before the world wakes up.
Raindrops tap softly against the glass, matching the slow, steady rhythm of a lazy morning.

I actually quite like when the weather forces us to slow down.
The steady downpour outside seems to blur the edges of the world, slowing everything right down.

I'm going to take my time and just enjoy this warm cup.
There is no need to rush when the weather itself is telling everyone to take a break.

Check the daily rule before trusting it.
The daily rule changes the move, so Isla checks it before trusting the answer.

There, that connection actually makes perfect sense now.
With the trickier parts of the puzzle sorted, the rest of the pieces fall into place.

Now that's settled, I think it's finally time for some breakfast.
Watching the rain gather on the leaves outside, she finally feels ready to start her day.
